auth_note: An API key is required; anyone with a free-to-register Europeana account can self-serve a Personal key, Project keys need a request.
bulk_access: https://pro.europeana.eu dataset download via ftp://download.europeana.eu/dataset/XML/ and OAI-PMH at https://api.europeana.eu/oai/record/
probe_observation: Probe with the public demo key wskey=api2demo returned HTTP 200 JSON starting {"apikey":"api2demo","success":true, itemsCount 1, totalResults 46542; ratelimit-policy header (meta.json) shows q=1000000;w=3600 for the demo project key.

evidence.quote: Anyone can obtain a Personal API key.
The metadata is available as CC0 the same way as all the metadata exposed via the API
The base URL for all requests is https://api.europeana.eu/oai/record/ .
Europeana may specify a limit per type of request and/or accross all Europeana APIs, to which you will be required to adhere.

not_established: Numeric rate limits (docs captured give only a fair use policy and say personal key limits were reduced until April 2026; the numeric policy appears only in a response header, not in docs); explicit cost/pricing wording; the original docs page (pro.europeana.eu/page/search) and get-api page returned 403 challenge; Terms of Use page not captured.
